278:
Soo, The Hunter SP Turret.This SP actually uses the buffed stat of heroes.
Meaning, you can stack this little guy's attack by buffing the hero, then summon turret, and then buff the turret again!
It also has decent hit count, ranging around 4~5 hit per second, depending on your Attack speed, and caps at 9 with max AS.
Not to mention due to its mechanics makes the buff he received before summoned a part of his base stat, this makes him not as weak to dispel.
However.
Fact still remain.
Without dispel, there is no competition. Deadly Soul is just much much better DPS wise.
So, use at your own leisure. Note that, only use this in a team that works around it.
Aka: A team that uses 2 AoE buffer and a hunter (preferably also buffs himself/herself with passive).
